checks.name: reverse drag keeps PRIMARY separate; explicit copy writes clipboard and transient feedback expires
double-click selects a path; right-click preserves it and only an explicit Copy item copies
wide-character continuation and combining mark are copied as whole Unicode text
triple-click joins a soft-wrapped logical line without adding a newline
double-click then drag expands by whole words in either direction
triple-click then drag expands by complete lines and preserves a hard newline
TUI right-click remains an SGR press/release; Shift bypass owns drag/menu releases after Shift lifts
right-click alone sends nothing; Paste delivers exact multiline UTF-8 bracketed bytes
clipboard shortcut and middle-button PRIMARY paste keep their existing meanings
arrow and Enter operate the temporary menu without leaking navigation keys
empty and rejected transfers show feedback without sending a paste bracket or partial text
menu clamps to window edges; outside click dismisses without reaching the PTY
read-only view can copy while its Paste item stays disabled and cannot acquire input
